architecture_review.trigger: Consequential clean-runtime architecture/provider trust, then conflicting primary evaluator/default evidence unresolved after one bounded Sol diagnosis
architecture_review.accepted_result: Accept the qualification wave and finalist roles, preserving all failures. Keep ai-memory as the operational reference; Hindsight is the priority quality/lifecycle challenger, and agentmemory's current evaluator qualification is blocked by session identity. No final backbone/token winner. Another embedding run cannot repair evaluator IDs. Use a maintained correction or supported matched harness before comparative quality/cost promotion.
architecture_review.correction: Linux bootstrap has no --plan flag; parser and native exit2 establish this. Do not generalize the macOS-only option.
architecture_review.dispatch_limit: The first follow-up dispatch hit the active-thread limit. Retried successfully after worker completion freed slots; this is dispatch capacity, not a native provider retry.
architecture_review.latest_recommendation_acceptance: Astra/max accepts Hindsight as fit-based shared-native target, strengthened by published SDE-bench comparisons. New ai-memory 2.5.0 features strengthen the competing fit but are source-only; no overall/token winner.

corrections.earlier_interpretation: agentmemory 0/15 implied no useful backend retrieval.
corrections.verified_correction: Native ingestion stored all 15 fixture records and smart-search returned results. The unchanged adapter prefers synthetic sessionId=memory, suppressing its fallback observation-to-session map. Both zero-score attempts are invalid for backend quality, while the current upstream harness qualification remains unresolved.

corrections.earlier_interpretation: The default keyless agentmemory run uses local MiniLM embeddings.
corrections.verified_correction: At the executed pin, detectEmbeddingProvider returns null without EMBEDDING_PROVIDER or a recognized provider key, and createEmbeddingProvider then returns null. A future local hybrid comparison must explicitly select the documented local provider. The current run did not establish MiniLM hybrid quality.

corrections.earlier_interpretation: The refused ai-memory restore created wiki scope directories.
corrections.verified_correction: Independent target inspection found logging scaffolding, not wiki scope directories. The native refusal and unchanged-target fixture failure are both retained. A bounded clean PID/network namespace retry passed without disabling the native global sibling-process guard.

next_acceptance: Identify a maintained upstream evaluator correction or supported matched harness that preserves fixture identity; the current agentmemory coding-life adapter cannot establish comparable scores.
Execute both native clients in disposable projects with ordinary trust and scope-isolation negatives.
Observe freshness, interruption/replay, deletion with seeding disabled, and independent empty-target recovery.
Run the binding matched quality comparison on current deployable profiles, including the production ai-memory reranker control.
Record initial and ongoing model, embedding, refresh, reranking, retry and downstream usage; keep cache and billing scopes distinct, and unknown usage unknown.
Promote one memory configuration only after those gates pass; a new distro and version probes cannot substitute for them.
